column1: # Representative gate counts and estimated Rent's exponents for open-source IP cores.
# Compiles representative gate equivalent (GE) counts and estimated topological Rent's
# exponents (p in B = k * G^p) across seven notable open-source processor architectures
# ranging from minimal microcontrollers (PicoRV32) to multicore superscalar SoCs (OpenSPARC T1).
# Gate counts reflect synthesized logic gates without macro memories.
# Rent's exponents are representative structural estimates illustrating wiring complexity
# growth rather than layout extractions from a single signoff PDK.
